🎉 VIDEOKEY V2.8 MAJOR UPDATE:
• Harap at Likod na Camera Background (Front & Back Cam toggle)
• I-tap ang screen para mag-Pause at Resume (malinis at walang sagabal na kahon)
• 100% Lyric highlight fix sa lahat ng phones at tablets (resilient audio clock)
• Pinatinding VIP Bass Boost at Treble Boost (dinig na dinig sa cellphone speakers)
• Customizable 5-image countdown (4, 3, 2, 1, GO)
• Customizable scoring fanfare sounds
• Mas mabilis, matatag, at super smooth na videoke experience
